title: Dedicated, accessible space for the dwelling's waste bins per local government requirements
text: C2.4.1 A dedicated and accessible space is provided to accommodate the required number and type of waste storage bins for the dwelling, in line with requirements of the local government.

replaces.note: Part C clause number inferred from the register's order
no Part B equivalent for grouped dwellings R25 and below

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: diverges: Chapter 2 C2.4.1 is bin screening (its Chapter 3 twin is C2.4.2); this dedicated-space clause has no Chapter 2 equivalent. Uses proposed fact services.waste.bin_space_per_lg_requirements; the local government's bin numbers and types are outside the R-Codes, so the applicant states compliance.
